COLEC11 (UniProt Q9BWP8) encodes a 271-aa precursor of **28.67 kDa** (monoisotopic 28.65 kDa; mature chain after signal peptide cleavage, residues 26–271, 26.11 kDa). NDUFS8 (UniProt O00217) encodes a 210-aa precursor of **23.70 kDa** (monoisotopic 23.69 kDa; mature chain after the 35-residue mitochondrial transit peptide, 20.29 kDa). COLEC11 is therefore the heavier protein under both precursor and mature-chain comparisons. COLEC11's length and mass were independently confirmed with RefSeq NP_076932.1 (271 aa, 28.67 kDa, identical sequence).

One caveat on the underlying data: UniProt's JSON/TSV summary fields for Q9BWP8 list length 203 and mass 21,499 Da, which contradicts the 271-aa sequence carried in the same record and the flat-file header ("271 AA; 28665 MW"). The 271-aa sequence is correct (RefSeq agreement), so the summary fields appear stale.
